title: CBIC Designates Officers for Central Excise and Service Tax Appeals
content:
# CBIC Designates Officers for Central Excise and Service Tax Appeals

Ek important update hai Central Excise aur Service Tax matters ko leke! Government ne appeals ke effective disposal ke liye designated officers assign kiye hain.

The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne **Order No. 01/2026-Central Excise dated October 5, 2026** issue kiya hai.

Is order ke key points yeh hain:
*   **Purpose:** CBIC ne Central Excise aur Service Tax laws ke under 1st July 2017 ya uske baad file kiye gaye appeals ko designated officers ko assign kiya hai, jo Orders-in-Appeal pass karenge.
*   **Modification:** Yeh order Order No. 04/2025 dated April 28, 2025, ko partially modify karta hai, jo pre-GST matters se related appeals ke assignment se concerned tha.
*   **Applicability:** Ismein Section 35 of the Central Excise Act, 1944 ya Section 85 of the Finance Act, 1994 ke under file kiye gaye appeals cover hote hain.
*   **Objective:** The move aims to streamline the handling of legacy appeals and bring more clarity and efficiency to the appellate process.
